description: Ground truth for hyd_circuit spec boxes: read by eye from rendered crops of each drawing, written BEFORE comparing with the extractor. See README.md in this folder for the method and its limits.

specs.pipe_dim_standard: DIN EN 10305-4 for Tubes up to 42mm OD. ANSI B36.10M for Pipes Sizes above42mm OD.

notes.text: SMPS is used to convert 110V AC to 24VDC.
Electric motor is suitable to overloaded by 60% for 15 second in every 144 sec. cycle.
U port of each Close loop pump shall be connected externally to L-Leakage line to eliminate air trapped in pump housing.

notes.text: Manifold Material - GGG40.
Cabling of Instrument to JB will be through metal conduit only. Cable from Instrument to metal duct and JB to metal duct will be through flexible metal conduit.
Suitable cable gland will be provided at both ends of connecting cable.
All solenoids will be wired up with oil resistance cable to junction box mounted on the valve desk.
